status: exploratory second step, fixed before any retrieval arm was trained or scored
metric: mean AUROC within the 8 strata (finding x current state), seed-averaged p_yes, test set
interval: as in gates.json: 95 %, SE_tot^2 = SE_boot^2 + Var(per-seed contrasts)/n_seeds; bootstrap within the 16 cells, B = 2000, seed 0
pool: training subjects' query ECGs with their next ECG; neighbours by ECGFounder cosine, never the query's own subject; no test or validation subject in the pool
adapter: ret: same samples, order, conditions and own-history draws as ctx, plus k_nb drawn uniformly from {0, 2, 4} neighbours
R1: retrieval adds to memory: S-ret-both (3 own, 4 neighbours) minus S-ret-own (3 own): interval above 0 and every per-seed contrast above 0
R2: what followed is read: S-ret-both minus S-ret-shuf (neighbours' next ECGs swapped within the same state for the finding): interval above 0 and every per-seed contrast above 0
reported: S-ret-nb (4 neighbours, no own history) minus S-ret-k0; text-condition versions; statisticians with a vote over the neighbours' next ECGs
